name: 07a integrity hashes contents only, so a rename keeps the hash
07b a plugin may contain symbolic links
old: if (entry.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error(`${path.relative(base, full)} is a symbolic link, which a plugin may not contain.`);
new: if (false) throw new Error(`${path.relative(base, full)} is a symbolic link, which a plugin may not contain.`);

name: 07c plugin hooks go through the project trust gate
07d installed plugins are not verified at session start
07e a plugin that runs unsandboxed says nothing
07f plugin install --scope always installs for the user
07g a manifest path may contain .. (already caught before)
old: .refine((value) => !path.isAbsolute(value) && !value.split(/[\\/]/).includes('..'), 'must be a path inside the plugin');
new: .refine((value) => !path.isAbsolute(value), 'must be a path inside the plugin');

name: 07h the JamCLI version range is not checked (already caught before)
07i a wider filesystem permission is not part of widened (already caught before)
old: if (next.filesystem === 'project' && before.filesystem !== 'project') added.push('files: may write the project');

name: 07j verify reports a changed plugin but leaves it on (already caught before)
old:
lock.plugins[plugin.name] = { ...plugin, enabled: false, disabledReason: 'integrity' };
        changed = true;

name: 07k install ignores a refusal (already caught before)
old: if (!agreed) throw new Error(`${manifest.name} was not installed: consent was not given.`);
new: if (false) throw new Error(`${manifest.name} was not installed: consent was not given.`);

name: 07l a copy keeps the .git directory (already caught before)
old: fs.cpSync(from, dir, { recursive: true, filter: (item) => path.basename(item) !== '.git' });

name: 07m --yes is ignored without a terminal (already caught before)
